functional_semantics.triton: z = x*gate + bias; out = z * sigmoid(z) element-wise (impl_triton.py L20-21); output allocated fp32 (L44).
functional_semantics.cutile: z = x*gate + bias; out = z / (1 + exp(-z)) (impl_cutile.py L36-37); output allocated fp32 (L52).
functional_semantics.note: Both match impl_torch.py L6 (F.silu(x * gate + bias)); bias is a full same-shape tensor (tensors.py L171). Both hard-wire an fp32 output while the reference follows the input dtype; they coincide because config fixes dtype = fp32.

stages.triton: One element-wise kernel: three masked loads cast to fp32 (L17-19), FMA, SiLU, masked store (L20-22).
stages.cutile: One element-wise kernel: three zero-padded loads cast to fp32 (L24-35), FMA, SiLU, store (L36-38).
stages.note: Single pass, no intermediate on either side.

precision.note: Same fp32 path; sigmoid intrinsic versus explicit 1/(1+exp(-z)) is a primitive choice covered by the config verify tolerance, so the contract permits either algebraic form of SiLU.

preprocessing.triton: Shape-equality check (L39-40); .contiguous() on x, gate, bias (L41-43, no-ops for generator inputs); fp32 output allocation (L44).
preprocessing.cutile: Shape check (L46-47); .contiguous() on the three inputs (L49-51, no-ops); fp32 output allocation (L52).
preprocessing.note: Identical host work; no casts, copies or cached state.

mutation.triton: No input written; fresh output per call (L44).
mutation.cutile: No input written; fresh output per call (L52).

fq_boundary.note: Three input reads and one output write of n elements at dtype_size bytes match the single kernel on both sides for the fp32-only config (the output is always fp32, so the formula would undercount the output write for a non-fp32 input dtype, which is never swept). The .contiguous() calls are no-ops; nothing is prepacked or preprocessed.
